why.text: The pedal's 6 wires and the dash switches never leave the cab. An engine-bay ECU would add 6 more firewall crossings.

boxes.what: Engine power box (MoTeC PDM15), which feeds the fan, injector and coil rails, starter, fuel pump, A/C clutch and lambda box

why.text: A PDM16 would fit the engine job. It has 16 outputs (8 × 20 A + 8 × 8 A), 12 inputs and 100 A total, against the 9 outputs and 2 inputs in use today. It uses Autosport plugs.
